policy: One exact reviewed primary-member fixture with a verified four-live profile and at least one current clean replay report represents its own group for sparse four-live first-pass breadth. New fixtures retain two clean replays at creation; after a shared-source change, one current compatibility pass can revalidate unchanged reviewed baseline fixtures. Two-current-replay diagnostics and finite completion gates remain separate and unchanged.
Sibling pitch variants inherit no tested branch or complete-card status. Groups absent from these rows have no saved primary scenario and remain uncovered.
Implementation flags identify candidates for investigation, not validated implemented behavior.
Secondary/support cards are excluded from primary counts; their separate original effect reviews remain available in the original metadata.
Recorded, reviewed, one-current-replay and two-current-replay facts remain separate. Global native control/suite/full-inventory readiness and finite completion remain separate existing gates.

branches: real Rout target departure / lower LP fizzles

inventory.digest_definition: SHA256 of compact UTF-8 JSON sorted [slug, existing four-file behavior SHA256] pairs; all five fixture files must exist
